entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Dominarian healer-in-training with the natural ability to sense danger and prevent damage; he dies healing Tor Wauki.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Leader of the entourage Kei healed for.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Wanted to lure Tetsuo to the Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Eumidian master assassin who infected Kei and mortally wounded him.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War in which Kei was infected.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Force Tetsuo's entourage was made to join as punishment.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Place where Kei served and the mana lines were poisoned.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Taken by Ayesha from Lord Magnus.

entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: Name of the figure who burned the evergreen, in truth the shapeshifter Halfdane.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Shapeshifter who impersonated Tor and Warbeard.

events.summary: Ayesha discovers Kei's abilities and trains and adopts him.
events.quote: decided to train and adopt him

events.summary: Ramses Overdark has Xira Arien infect Kei with her brood to lure Tetsuo to the Edemi Islands.
Tetsuo and Ayesha kill the insect inside Kei, but he keeps his mutations.
events.quote: he had to live with his mutations

events.summary: Tetsuo's entourage, Kei included, is forced to join the kentsu as punishment.
events.quote: was forced to join the kentsu as punishment

events.summary: Kei and Tor look for evergreens and find Ramirez DePietro protecting the sick; Halfdane, posing as Tor, attacks Kei.
Kei and the real Tor are mortally wounded; Kei uses his last energy to heal Tor, giving up his own life.
events.quote: Kei used the last of his energy to heal Tor
